create_pipe_config: create a PipeConfig by calling Pipe with a function, concurrency level, and optional executor
create_aggregate_config: create an AggregateConfig by calling Aggregate with an integer batch size or custom Aggregator instance
merge_pipeline_configs: merge multiple PipelineConfig objects into one using Merge with an optional custom merge operation
create_path_variants_config: create a PathVariantsConfig by calling PathVariants with a router function and list of processing paths
build_pipeline_config: build a PipelineConfig by composing SourceConfig, a list of pipe configs, and SinkConfig together
